cards.lesson: dic, dict = say, speak, show 說，指出，展現

core_words.decomp: dict(說) + ion(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 發音是決定「說話」時是否清晰的要素，也可以指在「說話」、「寫作」的過程中所挑選的字詞，引申為「措辭」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Children's authors must closely watch their ____ to ensure they use easily understandable words.
core_words.example_en: Children's authors must closely watch their diction to ensure they use easily understandable words.
core_words.example_zh: 兒童讀物作者必須留意措辭，確保使用容易理解的字詞。

core_words.decomp: e(e即ex，意思是外面) + dict(說)
core_words.formation_note: 「說」「出去」，引申為「公告」，後來又指公告出去的「法令」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：After the war started, the emperor announced an ____ to recruit every first born son into the army.
core_words.example_en: After the war started, the emperor announced an edict to recruit every first born son into the army.
core_words.example_zh: 戰爭開始後，皇帝宣佈一項法令來徵集每個家庭中的長子加入軍隊。

core_words.decomp: in(裡面) + dict(說)
core_words.formation_note: 索引可以「說」出書中重要名詞所在的位置。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Using the ____ of a book is a great method to quickly find what you are looking for.
core_words.example_en: Using the index of a book is a great method to quickly find what you are looking for.
core_words.example_zh: 使用書的索引是一種快速找到所需內容的好方法。

cards.formation_note: 發音是決定「說話」時是否清晰的要素，也可以指在「說話」、「寫作」的過程中所挑選的字詞，引申為「措辭」。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「說」(say) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：Children's authors must closely watch their ____ to ensure they use easily understandable words.
cards.example_en: Children's authors must closely watch their diction to ensure they use easily understandable words.
cards.example_zh: 兒童讀物作者必須留意措辭，確保使用容易理解的字詞。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: Will the world’s economists be able to p_____ the next financial crisis? 世界經濟學家能預測下次的金融危機嗎？ 【104統測】

cards.lesson: spec, spect , spic = look 看

core_words.decomp: spec(看) + ial(形容詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「看」起來「特別」的東西，往往會抓住你的眼球。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The restaurant's dumplings had a reputation of being ____ because of a secret family recipe.
core_words.example_en: The restaurant's dumplings had a reputation of being special because of a secret family recipe.
core_words.example_zh: 這家餐廳的餃子因家族秘方而特別享有盛名。

core_words.decomp: ex(徹底的) + spect(看)
core_words.formation_note: 表示「徹底地」「看」，引申為「期待」
core_words.prompt: 填空：I have been waiting a long time, so could you please tell me when to ____ Dr. Samuels to arrive?
core_words.example_en: I have been waiting a long time, so could you please tell me when to expect Dr. Samuels to arrive?
core_words.example_zh: 我已經等了很久了，所以請您告訴我 Samuels 博士何時能到來嗎？

core_words.decomp: a(朝...、去...) + spect(看)
core_words.formation_note: 原本是指「看」事情的角度，引申為「方面」
core_words.prompt: 填空：Electricity is essential in every ____ of our lives, from the cars we drive to the ovens we use to bake.
core_words.example_en: Electricity is essential in every aspect of our lives, from the cars we drive to the ovens we use to bake.
core_words.example_zh: 從我們駕駛的汽車到用來烘烤的烤箱，電力在我們生活的各個方面都是至關重要的。

cards.formation_note: 「看」起來「特別」的東西，往往會抓住你的眼球。
cards.takeaway: spec, spect , spic 表示 look / 看；「看」起來「特別」的東西，往往會抓住你的眼球。
cards.prompt: 填空：The restaurant's dumplings had a reputation of being ____ because of a secret family recipe.
cards.example_en: The restaurant's dumplings had a reputation of being special because of a secret family recipe.
cards.example_zh: 這家餐廳的餃子因家族秘方而特別享有盛名。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: The retired policeman is a r_____ citizen. 這名退休警察是一位值得尊敬的市民。

cards.lesson: view, vis, vid = see 看

core_words.decomp: view(看)
core_words.formation_note: view 的意思是眼睛所「看到」的「景色」、「視野」，也指「看法」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The ____ of the magnificent Grand Canyon is best seen from an airplane or helicopter.
core_words.example_en: The view of the magnificent Grand Canyon is best seen from an airplane or helicopter.
core_words.example_zh: 壯麗的大峽谷景色從飛機或直升機上看最好。

core_words.decomp: ad(「往…」) + vis(看) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「依某人之見、某人看法」，引申為「建議」、「忠告」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Barry was stuck in a difficult situation and begged his friend to ____ him on what to do.
core_words.example_en: Barry was stuck in a difficult situation and begged his friend to advise him on what to do.
core_words.example_zh: Barry 陷入困境，並懇求他的朋友建議他該怎麼做。

core_words.decomp: re(再) + vis(看) + e(動詞結尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「再看一次」，引申為「修正」，因為要「修正」內容，一定得「再看一次」。另外，revise也有「複習」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Try to ____ your notes every night for at least two weeks when studying for an important exam.
core_words.example_en: Try to revise your notes every night for at least two weeks when studying for an important exam.
core_words.example_zh: 在為重要的考試而讀書時，嘗試每天晚上複習筆記至少兩週。

cards.formation_note: view 的意思是眼睛所「看到」的「景色」、「視野」，也指「看法」。
cards.takeaway: view, vis, vid 表示 see / 看；view 的意思是眼睛所「看到」的「景色」、「視野」，也指「看法」。
cards.prompt: 填空：The ____ of the magnificent Grand Canyon is best seen from an airplane or helicopter.
cards.example_en: The view of the magnificent Grand Canyon is best seen from an airplane or helicopter.
cards.example_zh: 壯麗的大峽谷景色從飛機或直升機上看最好。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: If the interview ends quickly, it’s a sign that the i______ doesn’t think you are a good fit. 如果面試很快就結束，那表示面試官認為你不是一個合適的人選。

cards.lesson: audio, aud, audi = hear 聽

core_words.decomp: audio(聽)
core_words.formation_note: audio的衍生意思有「聲音的」、「錄音的」、「播音的」等，都跟聽有關。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Listening to ____ recordings of book chapters is a great way to practice second language skills.
core_words.example_en: Listening to audio recordings of book chapters is a great way to practice second language skills.
core_words.example_zh: 聆聽書籍的單元錄音是個練習第二外語技能的好方法。

core_words.decomp: audit(聽) + or(人)
core_words.formation_note: 在audit的後面加上表示人的字尾-or，形成auditor，意思是「審計者」、「旁聽者」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The company was required by law to give all its accounting documents to the tax ____.
core_words.example_en: The company was required by law to give all its accounting documents to the tax auditor.
core_words.example_zh: 法律上要求該公司將其所有會計文件提供給稅務審計員。

core_words.decomp: audit(聽) + ory(形容詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: auditory字面上的意思，即是「聽覺的」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Phillip had an excellent ____ memory, and often memorized songs after only hearing them once!
core_words.example_en: Phillip had an excellent auditory memory, and often memorized songs after only hearing them once!
core_words.example_zh: Phillip 具有出色的聽覺記憶力，經常在只聽過一次歌曲之後就記住它們！

cards.formation_note: audio的衍生意思有「聲音的」、「錄音的」、「播音的」等，都跟聽有關。
cards.takeaway: audio, aud, audi 表示 hear / 聽；audio的衍生意思有「聲音的」、「錄音的」、「播音的」等，都跟聽有關。
cards.prompt: 填空：Listening to ____ recordings of book chapters is a great way to practice second language skills.
cards.example_en: Listening to audio recordings of book chapters is a great way to practice second language skills.
cards.example_zh: 聆聽書籍的單元錄音是個練習第二外語技能的好方法。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: The stadium can accommodate an a_____ of 10,000. 體育場能容納10,000個觀眾。

cards.lesson: cord, card, cour = heart 心

core_words.decomp: re(回) + cord(心)
core_words.formation_note: 將「事件放回心中」，意思就是「記得」，後來引申為「記錄」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：If you want to find out who your ancestors were, you need to research the historical ____.
core_words.example_en: If you want to find out who your ancestors were, you need to research the historical record.
core_words.example_zh: 如果你想知道你的祖先是誰，你需要研究歷史記錄。

core_words.gloss: （梨子、蘋果等的）果核，果心；核心
core_words.decomp: cor(cor=cord，意思是心) + e(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: core是果心、核心。
core_words.prompt: 填空：To make a baked apple, remove the ____ and stuff the hole with raisins, chocolate, and broken cookies.
core_words.example_en: To make a baked apple, remove the core and stuff the hole with raisins, chocolate, and broken cookies.
core_words.example_zh: 要做一個烤蘋果，先去掉核，用葡萄乾、巧克力和碎餅乾塞進洞裡。

core_words.decomp: ac(朝...) + cord(心)
core_words.formation_note: 字面意思是bring heart to heart，亦即讓兩「心」趨於「一致」，因此有「和諧」、「協議」等衍生意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The war continued as opposing forces refused to sign the ____ which would end the fighting.
core_words.example_en: The war continued as opposing forces refused to sign the accord which would end the fighting.
core_words.example_zh: 戰爭仍在繼續，因為敵對勢力拒絕簽署結束戰鬥的協議。

cards.formation_note: 將「事件放回心中」，意思就是「記得」，後來引申為「記錄」的意思。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「心」(heart) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：If you want to find out who your ancestors were, you need to research the historical ____.
cards.example_en: If you want to find out who your ancestors were, you need to research the historical record.
cards.example_zh: 如果你想知道你的祖先是誰，你需要研究歷史記錄。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: The housewife keeps a r______ of everything she spends. 這位家庭主婦記錄她每天的開銷。

cards.lesson: ped, pod, pus = foot 腳

core_words.decomp: ped(腳) + al(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 是「用腳踩踏之物」，意思是「踏板」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Manny was afraid to ride his bike after getting his foot stuck in the ____ the last time.
core_words.example_en: Manny was afraid to ride his bike after getting his foot stuck in the pedal the last time.
core_words.example_zh: Manny 上次把腳卡在踏板上後，不敢騎自行車。

core_words.decomp: bi(二) + ped(腳)
core_words.formation_note: bi- 是「二」的意思，ped 是「腳」，biped 是「兩足動物」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：There are many animals that walk on two feet, but the ostrich is the fastest moving ____ in the world.
core_words.example_en: There are many animals that walk on two feet, but the ostrich is the fastest moving biped in the world.
core_words.example_zh: 用兩隻腳走路的動物很多，但鴕鳥是世界上移動最快的兩足動物。

core_words.decomp: im(裡面) + ped(腳) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: impede 的意思是「腳在腳銬內」，引申為「阻礙」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The explorers worried that the dense underbrush would ____ their journey to the cave of hidden treasures.
core_words.example_en: The explorers worried that the dense underbrush would impede their journey to the cave of hidden treasures.
core_words.example_zh: 探險家擔心茂密的灌木叢會阻礙他們前往隱藏寶藏的洞穴。

cards.formation_note: 是「用腳踩踏之物」，意思是「踏板」。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「腳」(foot) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：Manny was afraid to ride his bike after getting his foot stuck in the ____ the last time.
cards.example_en: Manny was afraid to ride his bike after getting his foot stuck in the pedal the last time.
cards.example_zh: Manny 上次把腳卡在踏板上後，不敢騎自行車。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: Ryan jumped on his bike, and p______ swiftly to the bus station. Ryan 跳上腳踏車，迅速騎到公車站。

cards.lesson: spir = breathe, mind, soul 呼吸，心，靈魂

core_words.decomp: spir(呼吸) + it(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 有「呼吸」代表活著、「靈魂」還在、「心」還會跳動。因此我們可以用spirit這個字來記憶spir這個字根的意思，spir有「呼吸」、「心」、「靈魂」這些意思，這三個意思幾乎是密不可分的。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Sophia strongly believed there was an evil ____ living in the attic of her grandmother's house.
core_words.example_en: Sophia strongly believed there was an evil spirit living in the attic of her grandmother's house.
core_words.example_zh: Sophia 堅信在她祖母家的閣樓裡住著一個惡靈。

core_words.decomp: a(往…) + spir(呼吸) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 為什麼渴望會跟呼吸有關呢？原因是看到渴望的東西，呼吸會急促，且心情亢奮時，會大口呼吸。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Some children ____ to be just like their parents when they grow up, but others crave the opposite.
core_words.example_en: Some children aspire to be just like their parents when they grow up, but others crave the opposite.
core_words.example_zh: 有些孩子渴望長大後就像他們的父母一樣，但有些孩子則不希望。

core_words.decomp: in(裡面) + spir(呼吸) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「往內吸氣」或「往內打氣」，引申為「激勵」、「鼓舞」、「賦予靈感」、「賦予靈感」，當你幫一個人「打氣」，就是要「激勵」、「鼓舞」他。至於 inspire 為什麼有「賦予靈感」的意思呢？你不妨這樣想，如果你在工作的時候感到精神萎靡、頭腦不靈光時，出去呼吸幾口新鮮口氣，往往靈感就來啦！
core_words.prompt: 填空：The race-winning 62-year-old marathon runner tried to ____ other elderly people to take up running.
core_words.example_en: The race-winning 62-year-old marathon runner tried to inspire other elderly people to take up running.
core_words.example_zh: 這位贏得比賽的 62 歲馬拉松運動員試圖激勵其他老年人開始跑步。

cards.formation_note: 有「呼吸」代表活著、「靈魂」還在、「心」還會跳動。因此我們可以用spirit這個字來記憶spir這個字根的意思，spir有「呼吸」、「心」、「靈魂」這些意思，這三個意思幾乎是密不可分的。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「呼吸，心，靈魂」(breathe, mind, soul) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：Sophia strongly believed there was an evil ____ living in the attic of her grandmother's house.
cards.example_en: Sophia strongly believed there was an evil spirit living in the attic of her grandmother's house.
cards.example_zh: Sophia 堅信在她祖母家的閣樓裡住著一個惡靈。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: The students were in high s_______ as they sang and danced. 學生們在唱歌跳舞時，都興致高昂。

cards.lesson: cap, capt, cip, ceiv, cept = grasp, take, have 抓，拿取，有

core_words.decomp: capt(抓) + ure(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 從「抓」，衍生出「捕獲」、「捕捉」等意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Kids all around the world love to ____ blinking lightning bugs on warm summer nights.
core_words.example_en: Kids all around the world love to capture blinking lightning bugs on warm summer nights.
core_words.example_zh: 全世界的孩子都喜歡在溫暖的夏日夜晚捕捉閃爍微光的螢火蟲。

core_words.decomp: ac(往…) + cept(拿取)
core_words.formation_note: accept 的本意是「拿取」，引申為「接受」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：It was difficult for Harry to ____ his poor test grade because he had stayed up all night studying.
core_words.example_en: It was difficult for Harry to accept his poor test grade because he had stayed up all night studying.
core_words.example_zh: Harry 很難接受他那差勁的考試成績，因為他熬夜在讀書。

core_words.decomp: ex(外面) + cept(拿)
core_words.formation_note: 字面上的意思是「拿到外面」，引申為「除了…之外」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The restaurant Shannon went to was out of every main course, ____ for the salmon.
core_words.example_en: The restaurant Shannon went to was out of every main course, except for the salmon.
core_words.example_zh: Shannon 去的那間餐廳除了鮭魚之外，其他主餐都沒有了。

cards.formation_note: 從「抓」，衍生出「捕獲」、「捕捉」等意思。
cards.takeaway: cap, capt, cip, ceiv, cept 表示 grasp, take, have / 抓，拿取，有；從「抓」，衍生出「捕獲」、「捕捉」等意思。
cards.prompt: 填空：Kids all around the world love to ____ blinking lightning bugs on warm summer nights.
cards.example_en: Kids all around the world love to capture blinking lightning bugs on warm summer nights.
cards.example_zh: 全世界的孩子都喜歡在溫暖的夏日夜晚捕捉閃爍微光的螢火蟲。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: Hundreds of civilians were taken c_____ by the terrorist group. 數百名平民遭恐怖組織囚禁。

cards.lesson: ple, plex, plic, ply = fold 對摺

core_words.decomp: sim(一) + ple(對摺)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「摺一次」，摺一次很簡單並不複雜，引申為「簡單的」、「樸素的」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：After being so afraid to try knitting, she could not believe how ____ it actually was.
core_words.example_en: After being so afraid to try knitting, she could not believe how simple it actually was.
core_words.example_zh: 在曾害怕嘗試編織之後，她無法相信它實際上是多麼簡單。

core_words.decomp: im(內) + ply(對摺)
core_words.formation_note: 將東西往內摺，目的是不想讓人家看到，衍生出「暗示」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The robber said many things that would ____ his innocence, but they were just not true.
core_words.example_en: The robber said many things that would imply his innocence, but they were just not true.
core_words.example_zh: 強盜說了很多暗示他清白的話，但這些話都不是真的。

core_words.decomp: re(回去) + ply(對摺)
core_words.formation_note: 「摺回去」，引申出「回覆」、「回應」等意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：It took too long for the company to ____ to a refund request for the broken product.
core_words.example_en: It took too long for the company to reply to a refund request for the broken product.
core_words.example_zh: 該公司花了很長時間才回覆損壞產品的退款請求。

cards.formation_note: 意思是「摺一次」，摺一次很簡單並不複雜，引申為「簡單的」、「樸素的」。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「對摺」(fold) 的字根

cards.example_en: After being so afraid to try knitting, she could not believe how simple it actually was.

cards.lesson: pos, pon = put, place 放置

core_words.decomp: pos(放置) + e(動/名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 擺姿勢時，我們會將動作固定「放」在某一位置上。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The professional photographer asked all the beauty pageant contestants to ____ dramatically for the camera.
core_words.example_en: The professional photographer asked all the beauty pageant contestants to pose dramatically for the camera.
core_words.example_zh: 專業攝影師要求所有選美選手在鏡頭前擺出誇張的姿勢。

core_words.decomp: ex(外面) + pos(放置) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: ex- 是「外面」，pos 是「放」，-e 是動詞字尾，expose 的意思是「放到外面」，引申為「暴露」、「揭露」，當你要揭露、暴露一些事情的時候，你必須把它放到外面去讓大家知道。
core_words.prompt: 填空：At the latest community meeting, residents helped to ____ some of the shortcomings of local government.
core_words.example_en: At the latest community meeting, residents helped to expose some of the shortcomings of local government.
core_words.example_zh: 在最近一次的社區會議上，居民幫助揭露了當地政府的一些不足。

core_words.decomp: im(裡面) + pos(放置) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「放到裡面」，引申出「強加」、「強制實行」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The world is very diverse, and one should never try to ____ their beliefs on someone from another culture.
core_words.example_en: The world is very diverse, and one should never try to impose their beliefs on someone from another culture.
core_words.example_zh: 世界是非常多樣的，永遠不要試圖將自己的信仰強加於來自另一種文化的人上。

cards.formation_note: 擺姿勢時，我們會將動作固定「放」在某一位置上。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「放置」(put/place) 的字根

cards.example_en: The professional photographer asked all the beauty pageant contestants to pose dramatically for the camera.
cards.example_zh: 專業攝影師要求所有選美選手在鏡頭前擺出誇張的姿勢。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: It is important to maintain a comfortable p______ while sleeping. 睡覺時保持舒適的姿勢很重要。

cards.lesson: port = carry, harbor 攜帶，港口

core_words.decomp: port(攜帶、出入口)
core_words.formation_note: port 的意思是「港口」、「避風港」，是一個可「攜帶」貨物進出的「出入口」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The massive cargo ship blew its loud foghorn as it sailed into the misty ____.
core_words.example_en: The massive cargo ship blew its loud foghorn as it sailed into the misty port.
core_words.example_zh: 巨大的貨船在駛入霧濛濛的港口時，吹響了響亮的霧角。

core_words.decomp: s(s-即dis-，意思是離開) + port(攜帶)
core_words.formation_note: 「帶走工作煩憂，遠離嚴肅的事情，進行娛樂來放鬆」，後引申為「運動」
core_words.prompt: 填空：Tyrell was not a person who enjoyed ____, so he chose to participate in musical groups, instead.
core_words.example_en: Tyrell was not a person who enjoyed sports, so he chose to participate in musical groups, instead.
core_words.example_zh: Tyrell 不是一個喜歡運動的人，所以他選擇參加音樂團體。

core_words.decomp: ex(外面) + port(攜帶)
core_words.formation_note: 「攜帶出去」，引申為「出口」、「輸出」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：In order to make more money on their products, the factory chose to ____ their goods to other countries.
core_words.example_en: In order to make more money on their products, the factory chose to export their goods to other countries.
core_words.example_zh: 為了替他們的產品上賺更多的錢，工廠選擇將他們的產品出口到其他國家。

cards.formation_note: port 的意思是「港口」、「避風港」，是一個可「攜帶」貨物進出的「出入口」。
cards.takeaway: port 表示 carry, harbor / 攜帶，港口；port 的意思是「港口」、「避風港」，是一個可「攜帶」貨物進出的「出入口」。
cards.prompt: 填空：The massive cargo ship blew its loud foghorn as it sailed into the misty ____.
cards.example_en: The massive cargo ship blew its loud foghorn as it sailed into the misty port.
cards.example_zh: 巨大的貨船在駛入霧濛濛的港口時，吹響了響亮的霧角。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: We have to arrive at the a________ before noon, so we had better leave for the station now. 我們必須在中午前到達機場，所以我們最好現在前往車站。

cards.lesson: tain, ten, tin = hold 握，保留，持有

core_words.decomp: con(一起) + tain(握)
core_words.formation_note: 把東西握在一起，引申為「容納」、「包含」
core_words.prompt: 填空：There is no denying that this red mushroom is beautiful, but it also ____ a dangerous poison.
core_words.example_en: There is no denying that this red mushroom is beautiful, but it also contains a dangerous poison.
core_words.example_zh: 不可否認，這種红色的蘑菇很漂亮，但它也含有危險的毒。

core_words.decomp: ob(前面) + tain(握)
core_words.formation_note: 「握住前面的東西」，引申為「得到」、「獲得」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Casey searched the online bookstore for the textbook she needed to ____ for her upcoming science class.
core_words.example_en: Casey searched the online bookstore for the textbook she needed to obtain for her upcoming science class.
core_words.example_zh: Casey 在網上書店搜索了她即將上的科學課所需教科書。

core_words.decomp: de(離開) + tain(握)
core_words.formation_note: 把人握著並強制拉走。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The police wanted to ____ the bank robber, so they needed to find enough evidence to arrest him.
core_words.example_en: The police wanted to detain the bank robber, so they needed to find enough evidence to arrest him.
core_words.example_zh: 警方要拘留銀行劫匪，所以他們需要找到足夠的證據來逮捕他。

cards.formation_note: 把東西握在一起，引申為「容納」、「包含」
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「握」、「持有」(hold) 的字根

cards.example_en: There is no denying that this red mushroom is beautiful, but it also contains a dangerous poison.
cards.example_zh: 不可否認，這種红色的蘑菇很漂亮，但它也含有危險的毒。

cards.lesson: car, cur, curs, cours = run 跑，進行

core_words.decomp: car(跑 ，車子) + r(重複字母) + y(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: car是車子，原本是跑的意思。在car的後面重複字母r，再加上動詞字尾-y，就形成carry，意思是「搬運」、「攜帶」，為什麼跟車子有關呢？因為車子是最佳的運輸工具。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The puppy got too tired on the walk with its owner, so she had to pick it up and ____ it.
core_words.example_en: The puppy got too tired on the walk with its owner, so she had to pick it up and carry it.
core_words.example_zh: 這隻小狗和牠的主人一起散步得太累了，所以她不得不把牠抱著走。

core_words.decomp: oc(朝著) + cur(跑)
core_words.formation_note: 若有件事朝著著你跑過來，即事情「發生」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：John is very scared of losing his job, even though there is little to no chance that this would ____.
core_words.example_en: John is very scared of losing his job, even though there is little to no chance that this would occur.
core_words.example_zh: John 非常害怕失業，即使發生這種情況的可能性很小甚至沒有。

core_words.decomp: re(回去) + cur(跑)
core_words.formation_note: 若事情或問題跑回去，表示事情或問題「再發生」。
core_words.prompt: 填空："If your symptoms ____, you need to come back and see me right away," the doctor said to her patient.
core_words.example_en: "If your symptoms recur, you need to come back and see me right away," the doctor said to her patient.
core_words.example_zh: 醫生對她的病人說：「如果你的症狀復發，需要立即回來就診。」

cards.decomp: car(跑 ，車子) + r(重複字母) + y(動詞字尾)
cards.formation_note: car是車子，原本是跑的意思。在car的後面重複字母r，再加上動詞字尾-y，就形成carry，意思是「搬運」、「攜帶」，為什麼跟車子有關呢？因為車子是最佳的運輸工具。

cards.example_zh: 這隻小狗和牠的主人一起散步得太累了，所以她不得不把牠抱著走。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: The woman suffered multiple m______ before she gave birth to her first child. 這名女子在生產第一個小孩前歷經數次流產。

cards.lesson: ced, ceed, cess = go , yield 走，退讓

core_words.decomp: suc(後面) + ceed(走)
core_words.formation_note: 「跟在後面或下面走」，因此有「繼任」、「連續」等意思，至於「成功」這個意思，是從「一個接著一個跟著，最後成功到達目的地」所衍生出來的。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The athlete knew he would ____ if he got up earlier in the morning to train for longer.
core_words.example_en: The athlete knew he would succeed if he got up earlier in the morning to train for longer.
core_words.example_zh: 這位運動員知道，如果他更早起床訓練，他就會成功。

core_words.decomp: ex(外面) + ceed(走)
core_words.formation_note: 走到外面跨越界線，引申為「超過」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：It's important not to ____ your scheduled hours at work, otherwise there will be no time to rest.
core_words.example_en: It's important not to exceed your scheduled hours at work, otherwise there will be no time to rest.
core_words.example_zh: 不做超過你計畫的工作時間是很重要的，否則你將沒有時間休息。

core_words.decomp: ac(朝…) + ced(走) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 是「朝…方向走」，若是朝某職位靠近，就產生「就任」、「就職」。此外，這個字也有「同意」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The robber did not ____ to the terms of the court, so he faced time in prison instead.
core_words.example_en: The robber did not accede to the terms of the court, so he faced time in prison instead.

cards.lesson: duc, duct = lead, tow 引導，牽引，拉

core_words.formation_note: 引導別人進來，就是「引進」，引領別人進入到你的世界最好的方法就是「介紹自己讓他人認識」，因此introduce也可以解釋為「介紹」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Xavier wanted to ____ Chantal to his best friend, but she said she felt too shy.
core_words.example_en: Xavier wanted to introduce Chantal to his best friend, but she said she felt too shy.
core_words.example_zh: Xavier 想將 Chantal 介紹給他最好的朋友，但她說自己太害羞了。

core_words.decomp: re(回) + duc(拉) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「把本來要給出的東西拉回來，降低數量」，引申為「減少」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：If you want to become more environmentally friendly, you need to follow three important steps: ____, reuse, r…
core_words.example_en: If you want to become more environmentally friendly, you need to follow three important steps: reduce, reuse, recycle.
core_words.example_zh: 如果要變得更加環保，你則需要遵循三個重要步驟：減少使用，重複使用，回收再利用。

core_words.decomp: ab(遠離) + duct(拉)

core_words.prompt: 填空：The animal activists broke into the chicken farm and tried to ____ as many chickens as they could.

core_words.example_zh: 這些動物激進份子闖入養雞場，並試圖劫走很多的雞。

cards.lesson: tend, tens, tent = thin, stretch 薄，伸展

core_words.decomp: tent(延展)
core_words.formation_note: 我們搭帳棚時會搭骨架，並將內外帳延展開來。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Annabelle struggled to put the ____ up on her own because the ground was so uneven.
core_words.example_en: Annabelle struggled to put the tent up on her own because the ground was so uneven.
core_words.example_zh: Annabelle 難以自己搭起帳篷，因為地面太不平整了。

core_words.gloss: 注意、專心、照顧、出席、參加
core_words.decomp: at(往…) + tend(伸展)
core_words.formation_note: 「往…伸展」，特指「專注力偏向某處」，引申為「注意」、「專心」。從「把專注力放在某人身上」，又衍生出 「照顧」的意思；此外，將專注力聚焦在某活動上，衍生出「出席」、「參加」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Kiera did not want to ____ her friend's wedding because they had a falling out recently.
core_words.example_en: Kiera did not want to attend her friend's wedding because they had a falling out recently.
core_words.example_zh: Kiera 不想參加她朋友的婚禮，因為他們最近鬧翻了。

core_words.decomp: ex(外面) + tend(延展)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「延展到外面」，引申為「擴大」、「延伸」、「延長」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Due to the dangerous weather, the school board chose to ____ winter break for another week.
core_words.example_en: Due to the dangerous weather, the school board chose to extend winter break for another week.
core_words.example_zh: 由於天氣危險，學校董事會選擇將寒假再延長一周。

cards.formation_note: 我們搭帳棚時會搭骨架，並將內外帳延展開來。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「伸展、延展」(stretch) 的字根

cards.lesson: tract, trait, tray, treat, tire = drag, draw 拉

core_words.decomp: treat(拉)
core_words.formation_note: treat是借自法語，和tract系出同源，都表示「拉」。treat這個字的語意幾經轉變，在拉丁文中產生「處理」的意思，後來又衍生出「對待」、「請客」、「治療」等意思。處理人與人之間的關係，衍生出「對待」、「請客」等意思；醫生處理病患問題，衍生出「治療」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：DeVito was ____ as a hero on his release from prison.
core_words.example_en: DeVito was treated as a hero on his release from prison.
core_words.example_zh: DeVito 從監獄出來時被視為英雄對待。

core_words.decomp: re(回來) + tir(拉 (tir=tract)) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: retire是「拉回來」，引申為「退休」、「撤退」，這個字是借自法文，拼法較不同。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Everyone has a different plan when they ____, but some enjoy volunteer work to keep themselves busy.
core_words.example_en: Everyone has a different plan when they retire, but some enjoy volunteer work to keep themselves busy.
core_words.example_zh: 每個人退休後都有不同的計劃，但有些人喜歡做志工以保持忙碌。

core_words.decomp: at(朝…(at=ad)) + tract(拉)
core_words.formation_note: 尤其指「專注力朝…拉過去」，引申為「吸引」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Since food can ____ bears when camping, it's important to elevate all snacks so they're out of reach.
core_words.example_en: Since food can attract bears when camping, it's important to elevate all snacks so they're out of reach.
core_words.example_zh: 由於露營時食物會吸引熊，因此重要的是要把零食放於高處，以免牠們觸手可及。

cards.formation_note: treat是借自法語，和tract系出同源，都表示「拉」。treat這個字的語意幾經轉變，在拉丁文中產生「處理」的意思，後來又衍生出「對待」、「請客」、「治療」等意思。處理人與人之間的關係，衍生出「對待」、「請客」等意思；醫生處理病患問題，衍生出「治療」的意思。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「拉」(drag/draw) 的字根

cards.example_zh: DeVito 從監獄出來時被視為英雄對待。

cards.lesson: act, ag = do 做，行動

core_words.decomp: act(行動)
core_words.formation_note: act本義是「行動」，衍生出「扮演」的意思。當名詞用時，有「行為」、「舉動」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Stacy was very upset when she found out that her friend's sympathy was all just a selfish ____.
core_words.example_en: Stacy was very upset when she found out that her friend's sympathy was all just a selfish act.
core_words.example_zh: 當 Stacy 發現她朋友的同情只是一種自私的舉動時，她非常沮喪。

core_words.decomp: ex(出來) + act(做)
core_words.formation_note: 本義是「做」「出來」，後來語意改變，表示不僅做出來，動作還高度「精確的」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Jason was starving, but he didn't have the ____ amount of money he needed to buy the sandwich.
core_words.example_en: Jason was starving, but he didn't have the exact amount of money he needed to buy the sandwich.
core_words.example_zh: Jason 快餓死了，但他沒有買三明治所需的確切金額。

core_words.decomp: en(使…) + act(做)
core_words.formation_note: 「使人民依規定來做事」，引申為「制定法律」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：In medieval Britain, a king or queen could not ____ laws without permission from the prime minister.
core_words.example_en: In medieval Britain, a king or queen could not enact laws without permission from the prime minister.
core_words.example_zh: 在中世紀的英國，未經首相許可，國王或王后不得頒布法律。

cards.formation_note: act本義是「行動」，衍生出「扮演」的意思。當名詞用時，有「行為」、「舉動」的意思。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「做、行動」(do) 的字根

cards.example_en: Stacy was very upset when she found out that her friend's sympathy was all just a selfish act.
cards.example_zh: 當 Stacy 發現她朋友的同情只是一種自私的舉動時，她非常沮喪。

cards.lesson: rect, reg = straight, rule, right 直的，統治，正確的

core_words.decomp: cor((即 com-) 加強語氣) + rect(直)
core_words.formation_note: 是「把…拉直」，引申為「改正」、「糾正」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：If you walk through the maze in the ____ direction, you will eventually find your way out.
core_words.example_en: If you walk through the maze in the correct direction, you will eventually find your way out.
core_words.example_zh: 如果你沿著正確的方向穿過迷宮，你最終會找到出路。

core_words.decomp: e(往上) + rect(直)
core_words.formation_note: erect是「直立的」、「豎起的」。當動詞用時，有「使…直立」、「豎立」、「建造」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Early humans began walking in an ____ position at least three million years ago.
core_words.example_en: Early humans began walking in an erect position at least three million years ago.
core_words.example_zh: 至少在三百萬年前，早期人類就開始以直立的姿勢行走。

core_words.decomp: di((即 dis-) 離開) + rect(直)
core_words.formation_note: 是「設定方向，直走離開」，引申出「指向」、「導演」、「指路」等意思。direct當形容詞，意思是「直接的」、「直達的」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：In 2018, Air New Zealand opened ____ flights between Taipei and Auckland for the first time.
core_words.example_en: In 2018, Air New Zealand opened direct flights between Taipei and Auckland for the first time.
core_words.example_zh: 2018年，紐西蘭航空首次開通台北直飛奧克蘭的航線。

cards.decomp: cor((即 com-) 加強語氣) + rect(直)
cards.formation_note: 是「把…拉直」，引申為「改正」、「糾正」。

cards.lesson: fact, fect, fic, fit, feat, feit, fair, fy = do, make 做

core_words.decomp: fact(做)
core_words.formation_note: 字面上的意思是做出來的「事」，引申為「事實」，事情都已經做出來，當然就成為事實了。
core_words.prompt: 填空：It is a well-known ____ that Geraldine has horse riding lessons every Sunday morning to prepare for competiti…
core_words.example_en: It is a well-known fact that Geraldine has horse riding lessons every Sunday morning to prepare for competition.
core_words.example_zh: Geraldine 每個星期日早上都有騎馬課，為比賽做準備，這是一個眾所皆知的事實。

core_words.decomp: af((af-即ad-) 朝向…) + fect(做)
core_words.formation_note: 事情做了就會產生影響，因此affect有「影響」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：If Jerome had known neglecting his homework would negatively ____ his exam outcome, he would have completed i…
core_words.example_en: If Jerome had known neglecting his homework would negatively affect his exam outcome, he would have completed it.
core_words.example_zh: 如果 Jerome 知道忽視回家作業會對考試成績產生負面影響，那麼他就會完成了。

core_words.decomp: ef((ef-即ex-) 出來) + fect(做)
core_words.formation_note: 是「做出來」，做出來代表產生影響，或者有效果，因此effect引申為「影響」、「效果」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Watering a plant too much can have a negative ____ on it, perhaps even killing it.
core_words.example_en: Watering a plant too much can have a negative effect on it, perhaps even killing it.
core_words.example_zh: 給植物澆太多水可能會對植物產生負面影響，甚至害死植物。

cards.lesson: gen = kind, birth, produce 種類，誕生，生產

core_words.decomp: gen(生) + t(詞幹衍生物) + le(形容詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 古西方人認為只有出身高貴的貴族，才具有「溫和的」、「有禮的」的特質。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The boisterous puppy was surprisingly ____ with his new playmate, a tiny kitten called Frank.
core_words.example_en: The boisterous puppy was surprisingly gentle with his new playmate, a tiny kitten called Frank.
core_words.example_zh: 活蹦亂跳的小狗對他的新玩伴–一隻叫 Frank 的小貓非常溫和。

core_words.decomp: oxy(酸) + gen(生)
core_words.formation_note: 古人認為「產生」「酸」需要「氧」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Some of the biggest challenges for colonizing the planet, Mars, is the lack of ____ and water.
core_words.example_en: Some of the biggest challenges for colonizing the planet, Mars, is the lack of oxygen and water.
core_words.example_zh: 殖民火星這個星球所面臨的一些最大挑戰是缺乏氧氣和水。

core_words.decomp: en(裡面(表動詞的字首)) + gen(誕生) + d(為了悅耳所添加，沒有意思) + er(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 表示「在…裡面生成」，衍生出「引起」、「產生」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Teacher Veronica wanted to ____ a sense of self-motivation in students, so she let them choose their own dead…
core_words.example_en: Teacher Veronica wanted to engender a sense of self-motivation in students, so she let them choose their own deadlines.
core_words.example_zh: Veronica 老師希望引起學生們自我激勵的意識，因此讓他們選擇自己的作業繳交截止日期。

cards.decomp: gen(生) + t(詞幹衍生物) + le(形容詞字尾)
cards.formation_note: 古西方人認為只有出身高貴的貴族，才具有「溫和的」、「有禮的」的特質。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「誕生、生產、種類」(birth, produce, kind) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：The boisterous puppy was surprisingly ____ with his new playmate, a tiny kitten called Frank.
cards.example_en: The boisterous puppy was surprisingly gentle with his new playmate, a tiny kitten called Frank.
cards.example_zh: 活蹦亂跳的小狗對他的新玩伴–一隻叫 Frank 的小貓非常溫和。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: Bob’s wife is five months p_____. Bob的太太懷孕五個月了。

cards.lesson: lect, leg, lig = gather, choose, read, law 聚集，選擇，讀，法律

core_words.decomp: col(一起) + lect(聚集)
core_words.formation_note: collect是由表示「一起」的col-，和表示「聚集」的lect所組成的，collect的意思仍然是「收集」、「聚集」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Jessica loved to ____ unusual rocks and seashells, and she stored them in an old shoebox under her bed.
core_words.example_en: Jessica loved to collect unusual rocks and seashells, and she stored them in an old shoebox under her bed.
core_words.example_zh: Jessica 喜歡收集不常見的岩石和貝殼，並將它們存放在床底下的舊鞋盒中。

core_words.decomp: e((e-即ex-) 出來) + lect(選擇)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「挑選出來」的意思，尤其指「將人挑出來」，引申為「選舉」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：To change the policies and laws in your city, you need to ____ the right government officials.
core_words.example_en: To change the policies and laws in your city, you need to elect the right government officials.
core_words.example_zh: 要改變你所在城市的政策和法律，你需要選出合適的政府官員。

core_words.decomp: se(分開) + lect(選擇)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「把選擇的東西分開」來，意思還是「選擇」、「挑選」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：It was difficult for the judges to ____ the competition's winner since all the contestants were so talented.
core_words.example_en: It was difficult for the judges to select the competition's winner since all the contestants were so talented.
core_words.example_zh: 由於所有參賽者都很有才華，因此評審們很難選出比賽的獲勝者。

cards.formation_note: collect是由表示「一起」的col-，和表示「聚集」的lect所組成的，collect的意思仍然是「收集」、「聚集」。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「聚集、選擇、閱讀、法律」(gather, choose, read, law) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：Jessica loved to ____ unusual rocks and seashells, and she stored them in an old shoebox under her bed.
cards.example_en: Jessica loved to collect unusual rocks and seashells, and she stored them in an old shoebox under her bed.
cards.example_zh: Jessica 喜歡收集不常見的岩石和貝殼，並將它們存放在床底下的舊鞋盒中。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: Lucy c_____ antique teapots for a hobby. Lucy 以收集古董茶壺為嗜好。

cards.lesson: vers, vert = turn 轉，轉變，輪流

core_words.decomp: vers(轉) + ion(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「轉」，引申為「版本」，每個版本間都有差異，這就是一種轉變。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The classic board game Monopoly is available in a wide range of ____ and languages around the world.
core_words.example_en: The classic board game Monopoly is available in a wide range of versions and languages around the world.
core_words.example_zh: 經典桌遊《大富翁》在世界各地有許多版本與語言。

core_words.decomp: a((a-即ab-) 離開) + vert(轉)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「轉移」、「轉離」，引申為「防止」、「避免」等意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Norman couldn't help but ____ his eyes when the villain of the horror movie came into the scene.
core_words.example_en: Norman couldn't help but avert his eyes when the villain of the horror movie came into the scene.
core_words.example_zh: 當恐怖電影的反派出現時，Norman 忍不住移開了視線。

core_words.decomp: ad(朝向…) + vert(轉)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「朝向…轉」，話題轉過去，引申為「提到」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Thomas ____ to his first skydiving experience in New Zealand during the speech.
core_words.example_en: Thomas adverted to his first skydiving experience in New Zealand during the speech.
core_words.example_zh: Thomas 在演講中提到了他在紐西蘭的第一次跳傘體驗。

cards.formation_note: 意思是「轉」，引申為「版本」，每個版本間都有差異，這就是一種轉變。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「轉」(turn) 的字根

cards.example_en: The classic board game Monopoly is available in a wide range of versions and languages around the world.
cards.example_zh: 經典桌遊《大富翁》在世界各地有許多版本與語言。
cards.source_quiz_prompt: Paul preferred the movie v_____ to the novel. 比起小說，Paul 更愛電影版本。

cards.lesson: ple, plet, plen, pli, ply= fill, full 充滿，充滿的

core_words.decomp: plen(充滿的) + ty(名詞、副詞、代名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: plen是「充滿的」，-ty是名詞字尾，plenty是「富裕」、「充裕」、「大量」，可以當「名詞」或「代名詞」使用。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Joseph cannot go out with his friends because he has ____ of things to take care of at home.
core_words.example_en: Joseph cannot go out with his friends because he has plenty of things to take care of at home.
core_words.example_zh: Joseph 不能和他的朋友出去，因為他家裡有很多事情要處理。

core_words.decomp: sup((sup-即sub-) 下面) + ply(充滿)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「由下往上填滿」，引申為「供給」、「供應」、「供應量」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：If an item's ____ drops but the demand stays the same, one might observe an increase in price.
core_words.example_en: If an item's supply drops but the demand stays the same, one might observe an increase in price.
core_words.example_zh: 如果商品的供應量下降但需求量維持不變，人們可能會觀察到價格上漲。

core_words.decomp: com(加強語氣) + ply(充滿)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「填滿」，後來語意改變，產生「遵守」的意思。
core_words.prompt: 填空：The student didn't ____ with the school rules, so he was punished with one week of detention.
core_words.example_en: The student didn't comply with the school rules, so he was punished with one week of detention.
core_words.example_zh: 該學生不遵守校規，因此被處以留校察看一週。

cards.decomp: plen(充滿的) + ty(名詞、副詞、代名詞字尾)
cards.formation_note: plen是「充滿的」，-ty是名詞字尾，plenty是「富裕」、「充裕」、「大量」，可以當「名詞」或「代名詞」使用。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「充滿，充滿的」(fill, full) 的字根

cards.lesson: part, port = part 部分

core_words.decomp: part(部分)
core_words.formation_note: 意思即「部分」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：Sally practiced the songs every night for two weeks to get a ____ in her school musical play.
core_words.example_en: Sally practiced the songs every night for two weeks to get a part in her school musical play.
core_words.example_zh: 為了參加學校音樂劇，Sally 連續兩周的每一晚都練習這些歌曲。

core_words.decomp: a((a-即ad-) 朝…) + part(部分)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「其中一部分朝…移動」，引申為「分離的（地）」、「分開的（地）」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：When the teacher noticed her students were passing a note, she walked over and tore it ____.
core_words.example_en: When the teacher noticed her students were passing a note, she walked over and tore it apart.
core_words.example_zh: 當老師看到學生在傳紙條，她走過去把紙條撕掉。

core_words.decomp: de(從) + part(部分)
core_words.formation_note: 是「部分從中分開」，引申為「出發」、「離開」。
core_words.prompt: 填空：After a major crash blocked the railway, all of the outgoing trains were forced to ____ late.
core_words.example_en: After a major crash blocked the railway, all of the outgoing trains were forced to depart late.
core_words.example_zh: 在一次重大事故阻塞了鐵路後，所有出站的火車都被迫晚點出發。

cards.formation_note: 意思即「部分」。
cards.takeaway: 用來表示「部分」(part) 的字根
cards.prompt: 填空：Sally practiced the songs every night for two weeks to get a ____ in her school musical play.
cards.example_en: Sally practiced the songs every night for two weeks to get a part in her school musical play.
cards.example_zh: 為了參加學校音樂劇，Sally 連續兩周的每一晚都練習這些歌曲。

core_words.decomp: ment(心) + al(形容詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「心理的」、「精神的」
core_words.prompt: 填空：He has a history of ____ disorder.
core_words.example_en: He has a history of mental disorder.

core_words.prompt: 填空：The police will not ____ publicly on the case.
core_words.example_en: The police will not comment publicly on the case.

core_words.gloss: 紀念物、引起回憶的東西

core_words.prompt: 填空：I keep this pebble as a ____ of our holiday trip.
core_words.example_en: I keep this pebble as a memento of our holiday trip.
core_words.example_zh: 我保存這顆鵝卵石作為我們這趟假期旅行的紀念物。

core_words.decomp: co(加強語氣) + gn(知道) + it(詞幹衍生物) + ion(名詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 意思是「清楚知道」，引申為「認知」、「知識」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The professor has done extensive research into theories of human ____.

core_words.example_zh: 這名教授對人類認知理論進行了廣泛的研究。

core_words.decomp: i(不) + gnor(知道) + e(動詞字尾)

core_words.prompt: 填空：I made a suggestion, but they ____ it.

core_words.decomp: not(知道) + ice(名詞字尾)

core_words.prompt: 填空：The French, as a ____, are often thought to be romantic.
core_words.example_en: The French, as a nation, are often thought to be romantic.
core_words.example_zh: 法國人作為一個民族常被認為是浪漫的。

core_words.decomp: na(誕生) + ive(形容詞字尾)

core_words.prompt: 填空：I'm sorry that she made some ____ remarks. I hope you don't mind.

core_words.example_zh: 我很抱歉她發表了一些幼稚的言論。我希望你不要介意。

cards.lesson: nov = new 新的

core_words.prompt: 填空：Not long after automobiles became popular, a new type of company was established, providing the ____ concept…

cards.lesson: jus, jur, jud, judg =judge, law, just 法律，公正的，判斷

core_words.decomp: jus(公平) + t(形容詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「正義的」、「公正的」
core_words.prompt: 填空：When the new king took his throne, the people hoped he would be a ____ and kind ruler.
core_words.example_en: When the new king took his throne, the people hoped he would be a just and kind ruler.
core_words.example_zh: 當新國王登基時，人們希望他是一位公正善良的統治者。

core_words.gloss: 公開保證放棄，聲明放棄（信念、行為、活動）
core_words.decomp: ab(離開) + jur(發誓) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「發誓離開…」，引申為「公開保證放棄」、「聲明放棄（信念、行為、活動）」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The Indonesian woman demanded that her fiancé ____ his Christian faith before he could marry her.
core_words.example_en: The Indonesian woman demanded that her fiancé abjure his Christian faith before he could marry her.
core_words.example_zh: 這名印尼女子要求她的未婚夫在娶她之前放棄他的基督教信仰。

core_words.decomp: ad(朝向…) + jur(發誓) + e(動詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「向…起誓」，後來語意演變成「要求」、「命令」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The local villagers ____ the priest to forgive the woman for her crimes and ask her to leave forever.
core_words.example_en: The local villagers adjure the priest to forgive the woman for her crimes and ask her to leave forever.
core_words.example_zh: 當地村民懇求牧師原諒這名婦女的罪行，並要求她永遠離開。

cards.lesson: poss, pot=power 有權力的，有力量的

core_words.decomp: pot(力量) + ent(形容詞字尾)
core_words.formation_note: 「強而有力的」、「有效的」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The poison from the tree frog is so ____ that one frog produces enough to kill 1,000 people.
core_words.example_en: The poison from the tree frog is so potent that one frog produces enough to kill 1,000 people.
core_words.example_zh: 樹蛙的毒性如此之強大，以至於一隻樹蛙產生的毒素足以殺死1000人。

core_words.prompt: 填空：The Spanish king sent explorers to the New World to find gold and to ____ the secret to living forever.
core_words.example_en: The Spanish king sent explorers to the New World to find gold and to possess the secret to living forever.
core_words.example_zh: 西班牙國王派出探險家到新大陸去尋找黃金和獲得永生的祕密。

core_words.example_zh: 在多年嘗試想要孩子之後，Mary 的丈夫去看了醫生，看看他是不是陽萎。

cards.lesson: contr, counter = against, opposite 對抗的，相反的

core_words.gloss: 反擊；相反的、對立的；相反地
core_words.decomp: counter(對抗的、相反的)
core_words.formation_note: 動詞意思是「反擊」，形容詞意思是「相反的」、「對立的」，副詞的意思是「相反地」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The city built a high wall for protection, but the enemy army used cannons to ____ this defense.
core_words.example_en: The city built a high wall for protection, but the enemy army used cannons to counter this defense.
core_words.example_zh: 這座城市修建了一堵高牆做為保護，但敵軍使用了大砲來反擊這一防禦。

core_words.gloss: 使對比、對照；對比、對照；差異
core_words.decomp: contra(對抗的、相反的) + st(站)
core_words.formation_note: 「站在相反的位置」，引申為「使對比」、「對照」，當名詞用時，意思是「對比」、「對照」、「差異」
core_words.prompt: 填空：The woman in the red dress ____ against the crowd of people who were mostly wearing black raincoats.
core_words.example_en: The woman in the red dress contrasted against the crowd of people who were mostly wearing black raincoats.
core_words.example_zh: 穿著紅色連衣裙的女子與大多穿著黑色雨衣的人群形成了鮮明對比。

core_words.decomp: en(裡面) + counter(對抗的、相反的)
core_words.formation_note: 「從相反的方向進入」，表示沒有經過事先安排，與人不期而遇，或者經歷一些事情，引申為「遭遇」、「巧遇」、「邂逅」
core_words.prompt: 填空：After their brief ____ in the hotel, Frank was certain that this woman would be his future wife.
core_words.example_en: After their brief encounter in the hotel, Frank was certain that this woman would be his future wife.
core_words.example_zh: 他們在旅館裡短暫相遇後，Frank 確信這個女人會是他未來的妻子。

core_words.example_zh: 看來法官確定會判那個犯罪的人有罪並判處他入獄服刑。

core_words.prompt: 填空：Insects have six legs and three ____ of their bodies: the head, thorax, and abdomen.
